We need distance. We don\'t have distance. We could estimate distance using estimate_distance but we don\'t have zipcodes. We could use get_zipcode_based_on_city for 河霧 and 石溪. We tried "河霧" and got zipcode "00000"? Actually earlier we called get_zipcode_based_on_city with city "河霧" and got zipcode "00000". That indicates maybe the function returns "00000" for unknown. Then estimate_distance returned error. So we cannot get distance.\n\nWe could ask user for zipcodes. Or we could approximate distance manually? But we can\'t call external APIs. We can ask user to provide zipcodes. The user didn\'t provide them. So we should ask for zipcodes. Alternatively, we could ask user to provide the distance directly. The user wants to know if the car can complete the trip. We can ask for distance or zipcodes. Let\'s ask for zipcodes.')
